titleEn: Give a staff member a seat

en: How do I give an employee access to Ebda Chat?

steps: Add the person as staff in Ebda Store (cross-product step)
edgeCases: seat_limit 403 when the package is full: remove a seat or upgrade
Staff removed/suspended in the Store lose access at once
gaps: Adding the staff user happens in Ebda Store; Chat cannot invite people
